title: HF219 (2021-2022 Regular): Farmed Cervidae provisions modified, firearms restrictions modified, portable stands permanently allowed in wildlife management areas, and Cervidae carcass transportation restrictions modified.

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Minnesota) (gun-policy Stage 5, Minnesota); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Minnesota text (1st Engrossment, 2021-01-28; official copy, https://www.revisor.mn.gov/bills/92/2021/0/HF/219/versions/1/)
provenance.note: Version read: 1st engrossment (2021-01-28), version_read other. No votes recorded. Bill is mainly a game-and-fish bill (farmed deer, portable stands, carcass import); only the firearms parts are quoted. Section 8 repeals Minn. Stat. 97B.318 (shotgun use area, slugs only). Old words struck in sections 3 and 6 are left out of the quotes.
